Group everything reachable downstream of an asset by propagation depth.

Unlike the flat lineage graph, this answers "if I change this asset, what
else is at risk, and how far away is it?" — one bucket per hop, with the
affected assets labelled for display.

Get complete audit trail for an asset with pagination and field selection

Parameters:
    asset_id: Asset ID (must be valid UUID)
    days: Number of days to look back (1-365)
    page: Page number for pagination (1-indexed)
    page_size: Items per page (1-500)
    field_filter: Optional field name filter
    user_filter: Optional user filter
    fields: Comma-separated fields to return

Returns:
    Paginated audit trail with all changes
    
Status Codes:
    200: Success
    400: Invalid input parameters
    404: Asset not found
    429: Rate limit exceeded
    500: Server error
